## Play the game

**[Open The Defiant Jazz Incident](http://localhost:8080)** (http://localhost:8080)

An observability murder mystery on Kipsake's Sleep Floor. You watch the testimonies and choose what to look into, while your own AI agent investigates the telemetry in this stack.

Everything here runs on your machine, from open-source parts. Nothing goes to Grafana Cloud. (The one exception is optional: the game's button to add your score to the public leaderboard.)

## Ask your AI agent

Connect any MCP-capable agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others) to the read-only Grafana MCP server:

```
claude mcp add --transport http grafana-local http://localhost:8000/mcp
```

or point an MCP "streamable-http" entry at `http://localhost:8000/mcp`. No MCP? Use [`gcx`](https://gra.fan/gcxrepo) with a Viewer service account (see the README).

Don't run your agent inside the repository's folder: it can read the spoilers.

## The data

Three open-source data sources are already set up, and the case is in all of them, tagged `service_namespace="kipsake-sleep-floor"` (`service.namespace` in Tempo):

| Signal | Data source | UID |
|---|---|---|
| Logs | Loki | `loki` |
| Metrics | Prometheus | `prometheus` |
| Traces | Tempo | `tempo` |

Open [Explore](/explore) to look yourself. Set Grafana's time zone to UTC so the times on screen match the story's.
